scope: Same two recordings and specific questions previously used to investigate retrieval failures. This is paired development evidence. No human QA labels or unseen generalization claim.

interventions.baseline: Original published lexical track-window search and normal Gemini answerer.
interventions.v2: Temporal retrieval, explicit requested-frame context, and deterministic checks of supported temporal claims; physically changed inputs rerun through the normal Gemini answerer.
interventions.v3: Identical retrieved pictures, inventories, model arguments and raw responses. Reran delivery validation only, adding the rule that a detector track number cannot answer a request explicitly naming an independent annotation ID.
interventions.separate_recovery: After sealing V2, a single separately authorized attempt on the byte-identical input of the one transport disconnect. The error stays in all primary comparison counts.

criteria: Same original questions, cutoff, online predicted track snapshots, temporal and box association thresholds, and strict grading categories used in the baseline. The independent AI reader checked submitted frames and highlighted identity for supporting citations, the original visual references, unsupported extra claims, and all abstentions and errors. A qualified answer gets no fully-supported credit.
